location.description: The location the Backend that this Traffic config applies to
location.rationale: Location inherits from backend configuration and has no independent security policy.

backend.description: Id of the backend that this Traffic config applies to
backend.rationale: Backend ID is a reference with no direct security implications.

target.description: Set to manually control the desired traffic for the backend. This will cause current to eventually match this value. The percentages must add up to 100. Structure is [documented below](#nested_target).
target.rationale: Manual traffic targeting has no specific security policy.

splits.description: A list of traffic splits that together represent where traffic is being routed. Structure is [documented below](#nested_target_splits).
splits.rationale: Traffic splits configuration has no specific security policy.

rollout_policy.description: The policy for how builds and rollouts are triggered and rolled out. Structure is [documented below](#nested_rollout_policy).
rollout_policy.rationale: Rollout policy must specify approved source branches to ensure only production-ready code is deployed.

disabled.description: A flag that, if true, prevents rollouts from being created via this RolloutPolicy.
disabled.rationale: Rollout enable/disable flag has no specific security policy.

disabled_time.description: (Output) If disabled is set, the time at which the rollouts were disabled.
disabled_time.rationale: Output field with no security policy.

codebase_branch.description: Specifies a branch that triggers a new build to be started with this policy. If not set, no automatic rollouts will happen.
codebase_branch.rationale: Codebase branch must be set to 'main' to ensure only stable, production-ready code triggers automatic deployments.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Project specification uses default provider project when not specified.

splits.rationale: Traffic splits configuration has no specific security policy.

build.description: The build that traffic is being routed to.
build.rationale: Build reference has no specific security policy.

percent.description: The percentage of traffic to send to the build. Currently must be 100 or 0.
percent.rationale: Traffic percentage has no specific security policy.
